summary: Terminal UI open requests prefer FRACTAL_AGENT while retaining ST_AGENT compatibility

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Terminal UI open request attribution reads FRACTAL_AGENT first, then ST_AGENT when the preferred name is absent. An explicitly empty FRACTAL_AGENT masks ST_AGENT. Unequal aliases omit agent attribution and warn using variable names only, matching the existing Rust identity environment resolver; matching aliases retain their identity. Request routing and UI layout are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service replacement or seat restart required.

manual.detail: Existing ST_AGENT-only callers remain supported. Resolve unequal manually authored aliases to retain agent attribution.

recovery.detail: No durable state migration. Existing request files and ST_AGENT readers remain compatible.
